newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady, interbank rate higher late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady, interbank rate higher late.

text.p: The Thai baht was steady in dull trade late on Wednesday in the absence of dealers in offshore markets that were closed for Christmas, dealers said.
The baht was quoted unchanged at 25.600-25.605 to the dollar late on Wednesday with some trading made at 25.593-25.598.
The Bank of Thailand set the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.58 against 25.57 on Tuesday.
"We did nothing today due to the absence of major players in Singapore," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The overnight interbank rate rose to 14.00 percent late from 13.50 earlier as local banks held on to funds to meet higher year-end market demand, dealers said.
"Most local banks were unwilling to offer surplus funds, preferring to keep them for meeting expected heavy withdrawal by clients," said another dealer at a European bank.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 9.70/10.30 satangs per dollar before close against 9.50/10.50 earlier.
